title: Sealed plaintext
description: What the envelope of secrets-answer.schema.json opens to: the digest, the requested credentials and a value for each, with when it expires and where it is set, nothing else. Whoever opens it checks run_configuration against the digest it computed and credentials against the set it requested. values has exactly one value for each name of credentials, sorted by credential. A member the schema does not define is refused, and so is a member name twice in one object.

version.description: The document format. A version other than 1 is refused.

run_configuration.description: The digest of the run configuration the values were sealed for, sha256= and 64 lower-case hex digits.

credentials.description: The credentials of the request, sorted.

values.description: The values, one per credential, sorted by credential.

credential.description: The credential's name, one of credentials.

value.description: The value: UTF-8 text of 1 to 16384 bytes with no NUL; the schema's maxLength counts characters and bounds it from above. A value set in a header must also have no control character other than tab and no leading or trailing space or tab.

expires_at.description: When the value stops working, RFC 3339, such as 2026-10-24T13:00:00Z: the gateway sends the secrets request again for this credential 5 minutes before, and after a host answers 401 to a request that the value was set on, at most every 30 seconds. A value that has expired when the run opens is run_configuration_invalid. Once it expires with no renewal, the gateway sets it no more. Absent, the value does not expire and is never fetched again.

apply.description: Where and how the value is set: items of the run configuration's apply. Each item is within one item of the entry, an API credential's being its endpoint's host with its auth: its hosts among that item's hosts, the same scheme, username and header, and paths that the item's paths cover. It may narrow the entry and never widen it. At a renewal, the items, or the entry's when there are none, are those of the start. Absent, the gateway sets the entry's items.
